articles.summary: Furthering its mission to enable agentic commerce at scale, payments company Cashfree Payments today announced the launch of Cashfree Here, India’s first ever payments extension that brings transactions directly into AI-chat applications.
articles.title: Cashfree Payments Unveils India’s First Payments Extension For AI-Apps; Launches Cashfree Here in Collaboration with Mastercard and Swiggy at India AI Impact Summit 2026
